# CPDataKit v0.10.2

Reports now retain public source links and recognised unit quotients. A DOI such as
`https://doi.org/10.1039/D2CP04680F` and units such as `mol / l` or `mV / s` no longer turn into
`[path]` in HTML, JSON or Markdown output.

The same sanitisation still removes local Windows, UNC and POSIX paths, URL user information,
sensitive query/fragment values and local paths passed in URL parameters. Regression cases cover
URLs next to local paths, paths containing unit-like text, chained unit quotients and repeated
sanitisation. Schema URIs use the same handling as other metadata.

The repair was checked with an author-supplied echemdb cyclic-voltammetry dataset: 3,501 rows and
three numeric fields remained unchanged, and the regenerated reports retained the DOI, unit
expressions and experiment metadata. This verifies data/report interoperability for that case;
it does not add native echemdb/YAML import or establish experimental validity.

Python remains >=3.12. Public APIs, file schemas and runtime dependencies are unchanged.
See the [verification record](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.10.2/docs/verification/2026-10-06-v0102.md).
